messages.subject: Project Cedar - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Attached is our first draft of the share purchase agreement. As foreshadowed in the HoT, recourse for the general warranties is structured to the W&I policy. The draft includes the tax covenant, the restrictive covenants and a £1.2m retention. Specific indemnities for the Doyle matter and the HMRC R&D enquiry are flagged. Look forward to your mark-up.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0834

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. We're working through it. Our principal points will be on the liability cap (your nominal-recourse construction won't fly for everything - we'll want a genuine seller cap on the carved-out warranties), the de minimis and basket, and the general warranty time limit. Mark-up to follow next week.

Jonathan
